project.description: Job 1: install and configure the Puppet agent on the test server. Polls the git repo's master branch every minute and starts the pipeline on a new commit.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # Job 1: install and configure the Puppet agent on the test server. # Runs on the Jenkins agent "test-server". Works on CentOS/RHEL and Ubuntu. set -eu PUPPET_SERVER="${PUPPET_SERVER:-puppet}" # Puppet's conventional server name PUPPET=/opt/puppetlabs/bin/puppet
if [ -f /etc/redhat-release ]; then rhel="$(rpm -E %rhel)" rpm -q puppet7-release >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo rpm -Uvh "https://yum.puppet.com/puppet7-release-el-${rhel}.noarch.rpm" # Only Puppet's repo is needed; skipping the others avoids slow or dead OS mirrors rpm -q puppet-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo yum -y -q --disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=puppet7 install puppet-agent else codename="$(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME")" if ! dpkg -s puppet-agent >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSLo /tmp/puppet7-release.deb "https://apt.puppet.com/puppet7-release-${codename}.deb" sudo dpkg -i /tmp/puppet7-release.deb && sudo apt-get update -q sudo apt-get install -y -q puppet-agent fi fi
# Configure: which Puppet server to use and how this node identifies itself sudo "$PUPPET" config set server "$PUPPET_SERVER" --section main sudo "$PUPPET" config set certname "$(hostname -f)" --section main sudo "$PUPPET" config set runinterval 30m --section agent
echo "Puppet agent version: $("$PUPPET" --version)" echo "Configured server: $(sudo "$PUPPET" config print server --section main)" echo "Configured certname: $(sudo "$PUPPET" config print certname --section main)"
# Prove the agent works by applying a one-line manifest locally sudo "$PUPPET" apply -e "notify { 'Puppet agent on $(hostname) is installed and configured': }"
# The agent service is left stopped: this setup has no Puppet server for it to # contact. With a server, start it with: # sudo puppet resource service puppet ensure=running enable=true
